facts.title: Gluten-Free Almond Cake with Berries on Top
ingredients: 2 cups firmly packed almond meal or almond flour (8 ounces), plus extra for dusting the pan
⅔ cup maple syrup or honey
1 ½ teaspoons grated lemon zest (from 2 medium lemons, preferably organic), plus more for garnish
1 cup plain Greek yogurt or whipped cream
½ pound ripe strawberries, thinly sliced
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
